identity.name: AllAfrica
identity.description: A pan-African news aggregator and distributor that republishes and produces reporting from more than 100 African news organisations.

ownership.ownershipNotes: AllAfrica Global Media is registered in Mauritius and Delaware and operates from multiple African cities and Washington, DC. It is a commercial aggregator with a pan-African public-interest mission.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Aggregator model with a pan-African editorial mission; framing varies by source publication rather than a single house line.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Least Biased and High factual reporting; aggregation dilutes a single editorial perspective.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic content spans source publications with varied perspectives.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Curates African-source coverage with a pan-African and development orientation.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High, but reliability varies by underlying source and aggregation adds verification risk.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Least Biased; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Pan-African aggregation voice. Surfaces African newspaper and agency reporting that global wires miss, with framing that varies by the underlying publisher.

selectionRationale: Provides broad African-source coverage that no single African outlet can match, with attribution caveats.

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping retained. Aggregator status means article-level verification is required before treating a story as independently confirmed. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
